Field reference

Identity & profile

Field Type Description
guid string Unique identifier for this agent instance.
uuid string Owner account UUID (the user who deployed).
agentguid string|null Catalog template GUID this instance was deployed from. null for custom builds (always check agent.custom === true to detect those).
teamguid string|null Team GUID when the agent is team-scoped. null for personal agents.
title string Display name you gave this instance at deploy.
description string|null Long-form description shown on the agent card.
cover string|null Per-instance cover URL, null until one is set with Deploy, Update or Cover. Show agent.cover when it is null.
categories array<string> Inherited from the template at deploy; editable via Update.
pinned boolean true when the user pinned this instance to the global header dropdown. Mutate via Pin.

Plan & AI usage

Field Type Description
tier string The agent's plan: "starter", "pro" or "max".
nextplan string|null The plan the agent moves to at its next renewal, set by a move to a lower plan with UpgradeTier. An agent subscribed before the three plans also shows here the plan it renews on. null when no change is scheduled. Also on MyAgents and PinnedAgents rows.
monthlypriceusd number The monthly USD price the agent pays, set at deploy, at a plan change and at renewal. Mirrors subscription.amount. Once a plan has ended, it shows the price the plan renews at, with that plan in tier: RenewSubscription never charges more.
usage object The agent's AI usage this period and the balance it runs on once the included usage is used up: { period, resetsat, includedusd, usedusd, leftusd, renewalusd, frombalanceusd, balanceusd, wallet, minbalanceusd, paused, pausedreason } (see Usage object). Also on MyAgents and PinnedAgents rows.
spend object What the agent cost this calendar month: { month, planusd, aiusageplanusd, aiusagebalanceusd, modelrunsusd, fundsaddedusd, totalusd } (see Spend object). Also on MyAgents and PinnedAgents rows.
creditperiod string 'YYYY-MM' tag of the current billing period. Rolls over on subscription renewal.
creditsyncat number|null Unix seconds of the last monthly usage reset, which starts the current billing period (null until the first reset).
tokenRates object|null Per-model token rates, in cents per 1,000,000 tokens. Shape: { default_model, fallback_rate, models: { "<slug>": { input_per_1m, output_per_1m, cached_input_per_1m?, cache_write_per_1m?, selectable?, label?, tier? } } }. Each turn's AI usage is priced from these rates. See Token Billing. null only on registry-read failure.
agentModel object The resolved model slugs this instance runs: { chatModel, cronModel, voicePrepModel, voicePostcallModel } (camelCase). Each falls back to the platform default when the operator hasn't overridden it. Change them via POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings using the lowercase keys chatmodel / cronmodel / voiceprepmodel / voicepostcallmodel.
enabledCommands array<string>|null The in-chat slash-command allowlist (camelCase read). null = the operator never customized it, so all slash commands are available. An array (including []) is an explicit allowlist of command keys (no leading slash); [] hides the slash-command menu. Write it via POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings with the lowercase enabledcommands key. Also present on MyAgents / PinnedAgents rows.
wiroApiAllowedPaths array<string> The Wiro API endpoints the agent may call with its own Wiro project key (camelCase read), for example ["POST /v1/Run/*/*", "POST /v1/Task/Detail"]. Always the list that applies: the agent's own list or, when it has none, the default list described under UpdateSettings. [] blocks all of them. Write it via POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings or at Deploy with the lowercase wiroapiallowedpaths key. Also on the Deploy and Update responses; not on MyAgents / PinnedAgents rows.
chatSetup string|null Setup From Chat as it applies to this agent (camelCase read): "all", "webchat" or "off". Write it via POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings or at Deploy with the lowercase chatsetup key. See Setup From Chat. null when it could not be read.
screen string|null The agent's Screen setting: "on" or "off". When it is on, the people who manage the agent can watch its computer live, in the Wiro panel or in your own app with a project API key, and the owner of a personal agent that has never been in a team, or whose browser was reset after it last left one, can take control of it; "off" closes both, everywhere. On a team agent whose Chat Mode (teamsessionmode) is "private", the Screen stays closed to the team even while this reads "on". See Screen and Take Control. Write it via POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings. null when it could not be read.
disk object The agent's disk space and how much of it its files use: { limitMb, limitBytes, usedBytes, state, measuredAt } (see "Disk object" below). The limit follows the agent's tier. See Disk Space.

Lifecycle

Field Type Description
status number Current status code (see UserAgent Statuses).
setuprequired boolean true if any required credential is missing or incomplete. Mirrors status: 6 plus a fresh check against the live credential rows.
createdat / updatedat / queuedat / startedat / runningat / stoppingat / stopdat / errordat number|null Unix seconds for each lifecycle transition. null until the corresponding state is reached.
lastactivityat number|null Unix seconds of the agent's last activity: the later of its newest message that isn't deleted and its newest AI usage charge (see Agent Transactions). null when it has neither yet. Also on MyAgents rows; not on PinnedAgents rows.

Composed children

Field Type Description
credentials object Per-provider credential map keyed by credential name (telegram, twilio-voice, wiro, var-support-email, …). Each provider object carries its saved field values, every saved secret read as the mask "••••••••", plus a fixed metadata header (see "Credential object shape" below).
customskills array Composed list of preset strategies and custom skills that aren't Scheduled Tasks (writable instructions). Each entry: { key, description, value, enabled, interval: null, requires_credentials, requires_connectors, _source, _editable, _edited, _user_created? }. requires_credentials (string[]) lists the channels and settings the entry needs, such as telegram or wiro; one of them set up is enough. requires_connectors (string[]) lists the Connectors a scheduled task needs, by catalog slug; one of them connected is enough. _source ∈ "preset-strategy" | "user-created".
scheduledskills array Composed list of Scheduled Tasks (cs-cron-*). Same shape as customskills plus interval (cron expression). A task whose requires_connectors isn't empty runs only while one of those Connectors is connected. _source ∈ "skill-bundle" (a Scheduled Task the template or a skill brings) | "user-created". A scheduled task that skills bring also carries the fields in Scheduled task skill fields.
skills array<object> Currently-enabled Skills (util-*). Each entry: { name, enabled: true, _edited, _user_created }. Toggle via SkillsApply (single-skill or batch). Note: object array (not string array).
skillsmeta object Inline registry snapshot keyed by skill name: title, icon, brand_color, category, docs_url, credential_key, requires_credentials, user_invocable, description. Lets the panel render skill chips without a Skills/List round-trip.
communicationChannels array Every external channel with this agent's state: id, title, credentialkey, required_fields, capabilities, schema, enabled, configured and missingfields. Also on the Deploy and Update responses; not on MyAgents / PinnedAgents rows.
enabledChannels array<string> The ids of the channels in communicationChannels that are enabled. Same endpoints.
teamsessionmode string The unified Chat Mode: "collaborative" or "private" for every agent. For team agents it drives Message/History, Sessions, and native web-chat memory scope; for all agents it also drives Telegram, Slack, and Discord DM scope. Team deployments/transfers default collaborative; personal deployments/team detachments default private. Write with POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings (team admins / owner only). On a team agent, "private" also keeps the agent's Screen closed to the team (see Who Can Watch).
timezone string|null Operator-selected IANA timezone (e.g. "Europe/Istanbul", "America/New_York"). null means UTC. The agent uses this zone for its scheduled tasks, for the times it gives on voice calls and for business hours. Write with POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings.

Scheduled task skill fields

A scheduledskills entry of a scheduled task that one of Wiro's skills brings (a cs-cron-* key from the skill registry) carries five more fields. Wiro gives the agent such a task only while a skill that brings it is on. These fields say where it stands with its skills and with the channels and settings in its requires_credentials. Like any scheduled task whose requires_connectors isn't empty, it also runs only while one of those Connectors is connected. A task without _owner_skills, such as one you wrote yourself, carries none of them and needs only what its own requires_credentials and requires_connectors list.

FieldTypeDescription
_owner_skillsstring[]The skills that bring the task.
_skill_offbooleantrue while the task waits for skills that are off. Wiro then sends it to the agent turned off, whatever its own enabled says.
_off_skillsstring[][]Only when _skill_off is true: what to turn on, one skill from each group.
_usable_credentialsstring[]The channels and settings the task's credential check covers (its requires_credentials), such as telegram or wiro; one of them set up is enough. [] when it needs none. Connectors aren't listed here: see requires_connectors.
_if_connectedobjectOne key for each of those channels or settings that isn't set up, with the groups of skills the task would still wait for once it is: the same groups as _off_skills, or [] when no skill holds the task back. {} when there are none.

To show a task as waiting, read _skill_off and _off_skills for the skills to turn on. Then compare its requires_connectors with each connection's status on ConnectorList: the task waits for a Connector until one of them reads connected.

Subscription & template

Field Type Description
subscription object|null The agent's subscription (see "Subscription object" below): its active one, else its newest, so a plan that ended reads status: "expired". null when the agent has never had a plan. It reads plan: "agent" and, since plans are paid from the Wiro balance, provider: "prepaid" (see Paying for Plans for a plan that was paid by card).
agent object Parent template summary: { guid, title, slug, headline, description, cover, icon, categories, tiers, plans }. For custom builds (agent.custom: true) it's a synthesized placeholder instead: { custom: true, slug, cover: null, icon: null, tiers, plans }, with no guid, title, headline, description or categories. Read the agent's title and cover from the useragent itself.
Credential object shape

Every provider entry under credentials.<key> carries:

Sub-field Type Description
_connected boolean Connection-readiness flag for a credential whose setup writes a connection time. Plain value credentials, such as the channels, can remain false; for those use _required_missing or inspect the field values directly. A connector's state is its status on ConnectorList.
optional boolean true when the agent template marks this credential as optional (the agent can run without it). false for required credentials. A credential nothing on the agent asks for reads true, with extra: false.
extra boolean true when this credential surfaces in the "alternative" / secondary group on the panel (rare; most credentials are primary).
_editable object Per-field edit map: { fieldname: true|false }. false means the field is read-only (platform-managed or computed). The frontend uses this to disable inputs.
_schema object Inline registry descriptor: title, icon, brand_color, docs_url, credential_mode, channel (on the external chat channels) and fields[]. Other keys are for Wiro's own panel: ignore them.
_required_missing boolean true when this credential is required (optional: false) and a required field you fill in is still empty. Drives the "needs attention" bullet on each credential card and the aggregate count badge in the agent's settings. Always false on an optional credential. A list field counts as empty while its rows hold nothing but a choice or a switch, such as a default platform on an otherwise blank row. A value the agent template holds counts as filled, even on a secret field that reads empty here.
_filled boolean true when the credential holds what the agent needs: at least one field holds a value and no required field you fill in is empty. A value the agent template holds counts, even on a secret field that reads empty here. For setuprequired, a credential counts only the values saved on this agent; see Setup Required.
connectedat string|null Credentials whose setup writes one: ISO timestamp of the last successful connection.
tokenexpiresat string|null ISO timestamp when the current token expires, or an empty value when the provider reports no fixed expiry.
<fieldname> string|number|boolean|array The field value as you saved it, returned to the agent's owner and team admins. A saved secret (a password field) reads "••••••••" instead, for every caller, and one with nothing saved reads "". Field types match _schema.fields[].type. Never returned: Wiro-managed fields, and a value the agent template holds on a field Wiro stores encrypted: such a field reads empty until you save your own.
Usage object

usage says where the agent stands this billing period. Amounts are in USD.

Sub-field Type Description
period string 'YYYY-MM' tag of the current billing period.
resetsat number|null Unix seconds when the plan's period ends (subscription.currentperiodend). The renewal that starts the included AI usage again runs up to a day later. On Detail, MyAgents and PinnedAgents, a plan that ended shows the ended period's end. null when there is no period to show or it can't be read.
includedusd number The AI usage this period includes. After a move to a higher plan inside the period, the higher plan counts only for the time left, so it reads between the two plans' amounts until the next renewal.
usedusd number The included AI usage used this period.
leftusd number The included AI usage left this period.
renewalusd number The AI usage the next renewal includes: the agent's plan's, or the scheduled plan's when nextplan is set.
frombalanceusd number The AI usage charged to the balance this period, after the included usage ran out.
balanceusd number The spendable balance of the wallet the agent uses.
wallet string "personal" (the owner's balance) or "team" (the team's balance).
minbalanceusd number The balance a new turn needs once the included usage is used up: 0.5.
paused boolean true while the agent can't start a new turn because it has no active plan or its balance is short (see pausedreason). A reached spend limit doesn't set it: Message/Send then answers code 93.
pausedreason string|null "plan": the agent has no active plan, because its plan ended or it never had one. It doesn't run until a plan is paid: RenewSubscription renews a plan that ended, and CreateSubscriptionCheckout (useprepaid: true) starts a new one. Adding funds doesn't start it. "balance": the included usage is used up and the balance is under minbalanceusd; adding funds runs it again. null otherwise, also while a spend limit holds the agent.
Spend object

spend says what the agent cost in the current calendar month (UTC), in USD.

Sub-field Type Description
month string The month the figures cover, 'YYYY-MM'.
planusd number Plan payments for the agent: a new plan, moves to a higher plan and renewals.
aiusageplanusd number AI usage covered by the plan's included usage. The plan payment already paid for it, so it is not in totalusd.
aiusagebalanceusd number AI usage paid from the balance.
modelrunsusd number Models the agent ran, such as images and video.
fundsaddedusd number Funds added to the balance from the agent's page. Not spending.
totalusd number What the agent cost: planusd + aiusagebalanceusd + modelrunsusd.
Subscription object
Sub-field Type Description
plan string Always "agent". The plan (Starter, Pro or Max) is the useragent's tier field, not the subscription's.
status string "active", "expired", "cancelled", or "refunded".
amount number The monthly USD price actually being charged. Mirrors useragent.monthlypriceusd.
currency string Always "usd".
currentperiodend number|null Unix seconds when the current billing period ends.
renewaldate string|null ISO-8601 time the plan next renews, or ends when it is cancelled: one day after currentperiodend for a plan paid from the balance, the period end for a plan paid by card. null unless the subscription is active.
daysremaining number Days until renewaldate, rounded up; 0 unless the subscription is active.
pendingdowngrade string|null "cancel" after CancelSubscription; null for normal active subs. A move to a lower plan shows in the agent's nextplan, not here.
provider string "prepaid": the plan is paid from the Wiro balance. "stripe" only on a plan paid by card before agent plans moved to the balance, until its period ends.
nextprovider string|null "prepaid" on a plan paid by card: it renews from the balance at the end of its period. null otherwise, and on such a plan once it is cancelled.
Disk object
Sub-field Type Description
limitMb number The plan's disk space in MB: 250 on Starter, 500 on Pro, 1024 (1 GB) on Max. It follows the agent's tier, so a move to a higher plan raises it as soon as the new plan starts.
limitBytes number The same limit in bytes: limitMb × 1024², for example 262144000 for 250 MB.
usedBytes number|null The size of the agent's files at the last measurement: its workspace, the media it generated and its temporary files. Chat history and system files don't count. null before the first measurement.
state string|null "ok" below 80% of the limit, "almost_full" from 80% and "full" from 100%. While it is "full", the agent can't save new files until some are deleted or the agent moves to a bigger plan. null before the first measurement.
measuredAt string|null ISO-8601 time of the last measurement. The files are measured about every 15 minutes while the agent runs. null before the first measurement.

POST /UserAgent/Update

Updates an agent instance's scalar fields only (title, description, categories, cover URL). A starting (status 3) or running (status 4) agent restarts in two cases: the call changes its title, or the body names none of those four fields, which is how you ask for a restart ({ "guid": "<useragent-guid>" }). The agent is moved to Stopping and re-queued after it fully stops. A description, categories or cover edit, or a title equal to the saved one, doesn't restart it. restarting in the response says which happened.

Parameter Type Required Description
guid string Yes Your UserAgent instance guid
title string No New display name
description string No New description (set to empty string or null to clear)
categories array No Updated categories. Cannot be empty if provided.
cover string No New cover image URL (set to empty string or null to clear). For multipart upload, use POST /UserAgent/Cover instead.

Scalar-only. Credentials, custom skills, skill toggles, and plan changes use dedicated endpoints:

What you want to change Use
Connect, list or disconnect the services the agent works with Agent Connectors: ConnectorConnect · ConnectorList · ConnectorDisconnect
Channel and setting credentials (bot tokens, the support email) POST /UserAgent/CredentialUpsert
The Wiro project the agent runs models with POST /UserAgent/CredentialProjectBind
Upload a credential fileinput field (multipart, e.g. Twilio voice MP3) POST /UserAgent/CredentialFileUpload
Custom skill values (strategy text, cron intervals, enabled flag) POST /UserAgent/CustomSkillUpsert
Rename a user-created custom skill (key + optional description) POST /UserAgent/CustomSkillRename
Browse alternative templates for a custom skill POST /UserAgent/CustomSkillAlternatives
Delete a user-created scheduled task POST /UserAgent/CustomSkillDelete
Turn one or more Skills on or off POST /UserAgent/SkillsApply
Change the plan (Starter, Pro or Max) POST /UserAgent/UpgradeTier
Upload a cover image (multipart) POST /UserAgent/Cover
Per-agent settings: time zone, Chat Mode, models, slash commands, Wiro API paths, Setup From Chat and Screen POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings
Sign the agent's browser out of every site (the agent restarts) POST /UserAgent/ResetBrowser
View / download / delete activity logs POST /UserAgent/Logs · LogsList · LogsFile · LogsDelete
Follow Scheduled Tasks, background runs and model runs live POST /UserAgent/RunStreamToken
Show the agent's live Screen, and Take Control, in your own app POST /UserAgent/Realtime/ScreenInfo · ScreenStart
Soft-delete a useragent POST /UserAgent/Delete

Note: CredentialUpsert and CredentialProjectBind never change status. An agent at status: 6 has no plan: pay it with CreateSubscriptionCheckout (useprepaid: true), which queues it.

Response

A changed title on a running agent:

{
  "result": true,
  "errors": [],
  "restarting": true,
  "useragents": [
    {
      "guid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
      "uuid": "ada-uuid",
      "agentguid": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
      "teamguid": null,
      "title": "My Instagram Bot",
      "description": "Updated description after rename",
      "cover": "https://cdn.wiro.ai/uploads/useragents/f8e7d6c5-cover.webp",
      "categories": ["social-media", "marketing"],
      "tier": "starter",
      "monthlypriceusd": 5,
      "creditperiod": "2026-05",
      "creditsyncat": 1714694400,
      "status": 1,
      "pinned": false,
      "setuprequired": false,
      "teamsessionmode": "private",
      "timezone": null,
      "agent": {
        "guid": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
        "title": "Instagram Manager",
        "slug": "instagram-manager",
        "headline": "Automate your Instagram presence with AI",
        "description": "An autonomous agent that manages your Instagram Business account.",
        "cover": "https://cdn.wiro.ai/uploads/agents/instagram-manager-cover.webp",
        "icon": "https://cdn.wiro.ai/uploads/agents/instagram-manager-icon.webp",
        "categories": ["social-media", "marketing"],
        "tiers": {
          "starter": { "priceUsd": 5 },
          "pro":     { "priceUsd": 30 },
          "max":     { "priceUsd": 100 }
        },
        "plans": [
          { "key": "starter", "title": "Starter", "priceUsd": 5,   "includedUsageUsd": 5,   "diskMb": 250 },
          { "key": "pro",     "title": "Pro",     "priceUsd": 30,  "includedUsageUsd": 30,  "diskMb": 500 },
          { "key": "max",     "title": "Max",     "priceUsd": 100, "includedUsageUsd": 100, "diskMb": 1024 }
        ]
      },
      "createdat": 1714608000,
      "updatedat": 1714694500,
      "queuedat": 1714694395,
      "startedat": 1714694400,
      "runningat": 1714694410,
      "stoppingat": 1714694500,
      "stopdat": null,
      "errordat": null
    }
  ]
}

Update returns the full composed useragent shape: same composition path as UserAgent/Detail, so credentials, customskills, scheduledskills, skills, skillsmeta, tokenRates, agentModel, communicationChannels, enabledChannels, and the agent template summary (with tiers and plans) are all included. The fields Update cannot safely populate without an extra round-trip (subscription, lastactivityat) stay omitted. Call UserAgent/Detail next if you need them, or the agent's usage and spend. Otherwise the response is suitable for an in-place panel re-render without a follow-up call.

restarting. true when this call restarts the agent, false otherwise. With true, the row shows the transition mid-flight: status: 1 (Stopping) with a fresh stoppingat timestamp. Wiro re-queues the agent once it has stopped, so it comes back with the new title. A restart request that can't be carried out answers Failed to restart user agent; try again.

POST /UserAgent/UpdateSettings

Writes per-agent preference toggles that are not credentials and not skill rows. Exposes timezone (operator-selected IANA zone the agent uses for scheduled tasks and voice calls), teamsessionmode (the one Chat Mode for team web-chat history and external-channel DMs), the four model overrides (chatmodel, cronmodel, voiceprepmodel, voicepostcallmodel) that choose which LLM the agent uses for chat replies, scheduled (cron) turns, voice-call prep, and the post-call summary turn, enabledcommands (the in-chat slash-command allowlist), wiroapiallowedpaths (the Wiro API endpoints the agent may call with its own Wiro project key), chatsetup (where people can change the agent's setup from chat), and screen (whether the agent's Screen opens, in the Wiro panel and in your own app, for watching its computer live and for Take Control). Submit any subset in the same call: partial updates are supported and untouched fields keep their current value.

Permission: owner or team admin only, as for /UserAgent/Update. Team members cannot change these settings.

Restart: if the agent is starting (status 3) or running (status 4) and the call changes a setting, the agent restarts so it applies: a new time zone, Chat Mode (teamsessionmode), model, slash-command list (enabledcommands) or Wiro API path list (wiroapiallowedpaths), or turning chatsetup on or off. Moving chatsetup between "all" and "webchat" doesn't restart it: Wiro checks that difference on each message. Changing screen never restarts it. A call that changes nothing restarts nothing. For agents in status 0/1/2/5/6 the change applies on the next start.

Parameter Type Required Description
useragentguid string Yes Your UserAgent instance guid.
timezone string|null No IANA timezone identifier (e.g. "Europe/Istanbul", "America/New_York", "Asia/Tokyo"). Pass null, "", or the literal "UTC" to clear the override; the agent then uses UTC. Unknown zones are rejected with Invalid timezone — must be a valid IANA identifier (e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul').
teamsessionmode string No Unified Chat Mode: "private" isolates each team member's Wiro web-chat history and native agent memory plus each approved external-channel DM operator; "collaborative" shares both runtime contexts. Personal agents can set it because external-channel DMs can have multiple operators. Web and external-channel message lists remain separate transports; room/thread sessions remain room-scoped. Channel activation remains credential-derived. On a team agent, "private" also keeps the agent's Screen closed to the team (see Who Can Watch).
chatmodel string|null No Canonical model slug for chat replies (e.g. "openai/gpt-5.6-sol"). Must be a selectable model, i.e. tokenRates.models[<slug>].selectable === true; an unknown / non-selectable slug is rejected with Invalid model: <slug> is not in the selectable model allowlist. A model that the agent's own Model Access rule blocks is refused with code 92. Pass null or "" to clear the override and fall back to the platform default.
cronmodel string|null No Same rules as chatmodel, applied to scheduled (cron) turns.
voiceprepmodel string|null No Same rules as chatmodel, applied to the voice-call prep turn (context assembled before a realtime call).
voicepostcallmodel string|null No Same rules as chatmodel, applied to the post-call summary turn after a realtime voice call ends.
enabledcommands string[] No Allowlist of in-chat slash commands the agent exposes, as an array of command keys without the leading slash (e.g. ["agent_help", "new_session", "agent_status"]). Validated against the command catalog: an unknown key is rejected with Invalid command: <key> is not a known agent command., a non-array value with enabledcommands must be an array of command keys. Order is preserved and duplicates are removed. An empty array [] is valid and hides the slash-command menu entirely. Omit the field to leave the current allowlist untouched.
wiroapiallowedpaths string[]|null No Limits the agent's own calls to the Wiro API, the ones its skills make with its Wiro project key (for example to run models), to the endpoints you list. It doesn't cover the tools of the wiro connector: those are the ones its tools on AgentConnector/Detail list. Each rule is a method in capitals (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or HEAD), one space and a /v1 path, such as "POST /v1/Task/Detail". A * stands for exactly one whole path segment: "POST /v1/Run/*/*" allows every model run, while "POST /v1/Run/x*" is invalid. Up to 64 rules of at most 200 characters each; duplicates are removed and the order is kept. Calls to endpoints that no rule matches are refused. [] refuses every call, model runs included; null removes your list, and the agent goes back to the default list. An invalid rule, or a value that isn't an array, is rejected with invalid-wiro-api-path-rule, and nothing in the request is saved. Omit the field to keep the current list. An agent with no list of its own uses the default list: POST /v1/Run/*/*, POST /v1/Task/Detail, POST /v1/Tool/List, POST /v1/Tool/Detail, POST /v1/Tool/UploadModelPostImage and POST /v1/UserAgent/Message/UploadAsset. If a custom skill of yours calls another endpoint, send a list that includes it.
chatsetup string|null No Setup From Chat: where people can change the agent's setup by approving setup cards in chat. "all" (the default): in the Wiro web chat and in messages sent with a project API key, such as from your backend or an MCP client. "webchat": only in the Wiro web chat on wiro.ai. "off": never from chat; the agent says that an agent admin makes the change in the agent's settings. null goes back to "all", and any other value is rejected with chatsetup must be off, webchat or all. Agents that your customers or many people talk to usually choose "webchat" or "off"; see Setup From Chat. Read it back as chatSetup on UserAgent/Detail.
screen string|null No Screen: whether the agent's Screen opens, in the Wiro panel and in your own app through ScreenStart with a project API key. The people who manage the agent (its owner and the team's admins) watch its computer live, and the owner of a personal agent that has never been in a team, or whose browser was reset after it last left one, can take control of it. "on" (the default) or "off". "off" closes it for everyone, watching and Take Control alike, in the panel and in your app, and also closes screens that are open, a Take Control session included, within about half a minute. On a team agent whose Chat Mode is "private" the screen stays closed to the team whatever this says. null goes back to "on", and any other value is rejected with screen must be on or off. It never restarts the agent. Read it back as screen on UserAgent/Detail.

Slash-command catalog. Valid enabledcommands keys are: agent_help, new_session, agent_status, agent_limits, last_scan, last_heartbeat, agent_restart, clear_all_sessions, clear_history. Read the agent's current allowlist from the enabledCommands field (camelCase) on UserAgent/Detail / MyAgents / PinnedAgents, where null means the operator never customized it (all commands available) and an array (including []) is an explicit allowlist.

Omitted fields are preserved. The handler distinguishes between "field not in the body" and "field present with null/""/value", so a POST that carries only timezone does not touch teamsessionmode or any model field, and vice versa. Sending an empty body (none of the recognised fields) is rejected with No fields supplied to update., so it never restarts the agent for nothing.

Read vs write casing. You read the current selection from the agentModel object on UserAgent/Detail / MyAgents / PinnedAgents in camelCase (chatModel, cronModel, voicePrepModel, voicePostcallModel); you write it here in lowercase (chatmodel, cronmodel, voiceprepmodel, voicepostcallmodel). The selectable set is exactly the models that tokenRates.models marks selectable: true. There is no separate "list models" endpoint, so read tokenRates to populate a picker.

An agent's own calls never manage an account. Calls the agent makes itself to the Wiro API with its Wiro project key are refused with HTTP 403 on account, agent, team and billing endpoints, such as /UserAgent/*, /Project/*, /Team/* and /Wallet/*, whatever wiroapiallowedpaths allows: An agent can't call this endpoint. An agent admin changes the agent's setup in its settings or with a setup card in chat. POST /v1/UserAgent/Message/UploadAsset stays open. On Task/Detail, and on Task/List, Task/Cancel and Task/Kill if your wiroapiallowedpaths adds them, the agent's calls reach only the tasks it started: a task your backend or anyone else started is not listed and answers as one that does not exist. An agent changes its own setup only through setup cards that an agent admin approves. A connector's tools are the ones its tools on AgentConnector/Detail list, and they act with that connection's own credentials. The wiro connector acts with the agent's own Wiro project key, so its calls are the agent's own calls, and these refusals apply to them too.

Request
# Set IANA timezone only
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "timezone": "Europe/Istanbul"
  }'

# Clear timezone (back to system default UTC)
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "timezone": null
  }'

# Change the one Chat Mode for team web chat and external-channel DMs
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "teamsessionmode": "collaborative"
  }'

# Switch the chat + cron model (each must be selectable; "" / null resets to default)
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "chatmodel": "openai/gpt-5.5",
    "cronmodel": "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
  }'

# Restrict the in-chat slash-command menu (empty array hides it entirely)
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "enabledcommands": ["agent_help", "new_session", "agent_status"]
  }'

# Limit the agent's own Wiro API calls to model lookups, model runs and task reads
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "wiroapiallowedpaths": ["POST /v1/Tool/List", "POST /v1/Tool/Detail", "POST /v1/Run/*/*", "POST /v1/Task/Detail"]
  }'

# Let setup changes from chat come only from the Wiro web chat
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "chatsetup": "webchat"
  }'

# Keep this agent's Screen closed: nobody can watch it or take control
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "screen": "off"
  }'

# Update both preference toggles in one call
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/UpdateSettings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321",
    "timezone": "Europe/Istanbul",
    "teamsessionmode": "collaborative"
  }'
Response
{
  "result": true,
  "errors": []
}

Light response by design. UpdateSettings returns just result + errors, not the full useragent shape. Pull the refreshed row with POST /UserAgent/Detail if you need to re-render the panel after the write.

Common errors

Each of these comes back with HTTP 200 and result: false, like every API answer (see Error Reference), and nothing is saved:

errors[0].code Message When
0 Request parameter [useragentguid] required useragentguid missing from the body.
0 No fields supplied to update. Body had none of the recognised fields (timezone, teamsessionmode, a model override, enabledcommands, wiroapiallowedpaths, chatsetup or screen).
0 Invalid timezone — must be a valid IANA identifier (e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul'). timezone is not a valid IANA time zone.
0 teamsessionmode must be private or collaborative teamsessionmode wasn't one of the two supported values.
0 directchatmode is not accepted; teamsessionmode is the unified chat mode Obsolete separate mode was sent instead of unified teamsessionmode.
0 Invalid model: <slug> is not in the selectable model allowlist. A model override (chatmodel / cronmodel / voiceprepmodel / voicepostcallmodel) was an unknown or non-selectable slug (tokenRates.models[<slug>].selectable !== true).
92 The Model Access rule's sentence, such as This agent can't use openai/gpt-5.5. Model Access rules decide which models can run. A model override that a Model Access rule for the agent blocks.
0 enabledcommands must be an array of command keys. enabledcommands was present but not an array.
0 Invalid command: <key> is not a known agent command. enabledcommands contained a key that isn't in the slash-command catalog.
0 invalid-wiro-api-path-rule wiroapiallowedpaths was not an array, or a rule broke the format or the limits above.
0 chatsetup must be off, webchat or all chatsetup wasn't "all", "webchat", "off" or null.
0 screen must be on or off screen wasn't "on", "off" or null.
95 User agent not found Unknown guid, or the agent has been deleted.
96 You don't have access to this user agent Caller is neither the owner nor on the agent's team.
97 Only a team admin can perform this action on a team-owned agent. Caller is a member of the agent's team but not a team admin.
0 Failed to update user agent — please retry. The write failed (transient, safe to retry).

POST /UserAgent/ResetBrowser

Signs the agent's browser out of every site. The agent's whole browser profile is deleted, with its sign-ins, cookies, history and saved site data, and the agent restarts with a fresh browser. Its files, memory and Connectors stay as they are. A reset is also how an agent that was in a team gets Take Control back: see Resetting the Browser.

Permission: owner or team admin only, as for UpdateSettings, with a signed-in session or a project API key. Team members can't reset it.

Restart: only a starting (status 3) or running (status 4) agent can be reset. The call moves it to Stopping (status 1), and its browser is reset as it starts again, about a minute later (see Automatic Restart). An agent in any other status is refused, and a refused call restarts nothing.

Parameter Type Required Description
useragentguid string Yes Your UserAgent instance guid.
Request
curl -X POST "https://api.wiro.ai/v1/UserAgent/ResetBrowser" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIRO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "useragentguid": "f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321"
  }'
Response
{
  "result": true,
  "restarting": true,
  "errors": []
}

restarting is true once the agent is restarting for the reset; read Detail to follow its status from Stopping back to Running. Each reset adds an AGENT_BROWSER_RESET row, Agent browser reset, to the agent's activity log, with who did it (see Who-did-what rows).

Common errors

A refused call answers result: false and restarting: false with one entry in errors, and restarts nothing:

{
  "result": false,
  "restarting": false,
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "The agent is not running. Start it, then reset its browser.",
      "time": 1795113000
    }
  ]
}
Error Code When
Request parameter [useragentguid] required 0 useragentguid is missing or blank
This agent's browser can't be reset. 96 The agent is Studio or the Workflow Agent
User agent not found 95 Unknown guid, or the agent has been deleted
You don't have access to this user agent 96 The caller is neither the agent's owner nor on its team
Only a team admin can perform this action on a team-owned agent. 97 The caller is a plain member of the agent's team
The agent is not running. Start it, then reset its browser. 0 The agent is stopped (status 0), in error (5) or in Setup Required (6)
The agent is starting or stopping. Try again once it is running. 0 The agent is stopping (status 1) or queued (2)
Reset Browser is not available for this agent yet. Try again later. 0 Reset Browser can't be used on this agent at the moment
The browser could not be reset just now. Try again in a minute. 0 The reset could not be started. Try again in a minute

POST /UserAgent/Cover

Uploads a new cover image for the agent instance via multipart. Mirrors the /User/Avatar pattern: accepts jpg, png, gif, jpeg, webp; converts it to webp and saves its URL as the agent's cover.

If you already have a hosted URL, use POST /UserAgent/Update with cover: "<url>" instead.

Multipart fields:

Field Type Required Description
useragentguid text Yes Your UserAgent instance guid
image file Yes The cover image file (jpg/png/gif/jpeg/webp, max ~10MB)
Response
{
  "result": true,
  "errors": [],
  "cover": "https://cdn.wiro.ai/uploads/useragents/f8e7d6c5-b4a3-2190-fedc-ba0987654321-cover.webp",

    {
